example.a:
Zara said, “I like surfing.”

Zara said that she liked surfing.
example.sound: Zara said, “I like surfing.” Zara said that she liked surfing.

atoms.a: Isla said, “I watch a lot of TV in my free time.”
atoms.b: Isla said that she ((++watched watch will_watch)) a lot of TV in her free time.

atoms.a: Olivia said, “Leonardo is reading in the living room.”
atoms.b: Olivia said that Leonardo ((++was_reading is_reading is_going_to_read)) in the living room.”

atoms.a: Ava said, “We bought a new couch.”
atoms.b: Ava said that they ((++had_bought bought should_buy)) a new couch.

atoms.a: Diego said, “I have never been to Australia before.”
atoms.b: Diego said that he ((++had_never_been have_never_been never_was)) to Australia before.

atoms.a: Jakub said, “I was going grocery shopping with my dad when I saw my classmate.”

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das Verb in der richtigen Zeitform auswählst.

atoms.a: Hassan said, “I will audition for a role in the theatre play.”
atoms.b: Hassan said that he ((++would_audition will_audition auditioned)) for a role in the theatre play.

atoms.a: Zahara said, “I am going to spend a year abroad after graduation.”
atoms.b: Zahara said that she ((++was_going_to_spend is_going_to_spend will_spend)) a year abroad after graduation.

atoms.a: Hiroshi said, “I can do a backflip.”
atoms.b: Hiroshi said that he ((++could_do can_do had_done)) a backflip.

atoms.a: Nala said, “I must write a poem for my English classes.”
atoms.b: Nala said that she ((++had_to_write must_write was_writing)) a poem for her English classes.

atoms.a: Alex said, “We may use our phones in the school breaks.”
atoms.b: Alex said that they ((might_use may_use had_been_using)) their phones in the school breaks.

atoms.b: Es kommt zu keiner Verschiebung der Zeitform in der indirekten Rede, wenn ((++would,_could,_should,_might will,_can,_must,_may)) benutzt werden.

atoms.b: Die Zeitform bleibt in der indirekten Rede auch bestehen, wenn die wiedergegebene Aussage ((++allgemeingültig spezifisch)) ist.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das Verb in der richtigen Zeitform in die Lücken schreibst.

atoms.a: Yasemin said, “We could meet after the dance practice on Monday.”
atoms.b: Yasemin said that we ((could_meet)) after the dance practice on Monday.

atoms.a: Victoria said, “Canada is a country in North America.”
atoms.b: Victoria said that Canada ((is)) a country in North America.

atoms.a: Maliya said, “I dyed my hair blue.”
atoms.b: Maliya said that she ((had_dyed)) her hair blue.
